_comment: GW-ARCH-001 section 6.3. Maps the Pawsome3D/Blender-authored rig observed in the supplied source models onto GIBI_QUADRUPED_V1. Joint names are CASE-SENSITIVE. Derived from inspection of randy11.glb and two Pawsome3D outputs, all 25 deform bones, generator 'Khronos glTF Blender I/O v5.1.20'.

root.reason: Section 6.3 requires an explicit 'root'. The source rig parents everything to 'hips'. A zero-transform root is inserted above pelvis so the deterministic motion controller owns translation and yaw while clips stay in-place.

clipsToDrop.pee_legLift: Out of scope. Section 1.2 restricts content to kind companion play; elimination behaviour is not in the section 6.3 clip table.
clipsToDrop.eat: Not in the section 6.3 clip table. Section 1.2 excludes hunger mechanics.
clipsToDrop.eating: Duplicate of 'eat'. Not in the clip table.
clipsToDrop.drink: Not in the section 6.3 clip table.
clipsToDrop.drinking: Duplicate of 'drink'. Not in the clip table.

requiredTransforms: Strip ALL scale curves. Section 6.3: 'Scale curves are forbidden.'
Force root transform to identity within 1e-4.
Disable root rotation on turn_l_90 / turn_r_90 at import.
Resample to <= 30 fps after key reduction.
Decimate LOD0 to <= 35,000 triangles (source is ~40,000; ~14% reduction required).
